title: Murder Mystery Sunset Boat Cruise 2 Hours
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Step aboard one of the most unique private sunset boat tours on Lake Tahoe and become part of the mystery. Our Murder Mystery Sunset Boat Cruise combines the beauty of a Lake Tahoe sunset cruise with the fun of a live whodunit, creating an experience that is part sightseeing tour, part interactive mystery, and completely unforgettable. As you cruise past stunning shoreline scenery, iconic Tahoe landmarks, and glowing Sierra sunset views, you’ll follow clues, uncover secrets, and work to solve a murder mystery set on the lake. For visitors searching for a fun thing to do in Lake Tahoe, a unique sunset boat ride, or an unforgettable Lake Tahoe boat tour, this experience delivers scenic beauty, suspense, and entertainment all in one private charter adventure.
